headline: SUPER JUNIOR's Kyuhyun brings winter ballads to 'Limousine Service'
sub: Four-song live set with host Lee Mujin on KBS Kpop
caption:
SUPER JUNIOR's Kyuhyun is the guest on episode 244 of Lee Mujin's live show 'Limousine Service'.

On the KBS Kpop channel, he sings 'Promise', covers Lee Young Hoon's 'A Kind of Confession' and Park Ki Young's 'Last Love', then closes with a duet of 'Winter Child' alongside host Lee Mujin. A cozy winter set from one of K-pop's top vocalists.

📌 Source: KBS Kpop official YouTube
